items.heading: Khorovats
details: Key ingredients: pork or lamb, onion, bell peppers, tomatoes
Marinate cubed meat with onions and a splash of vinegar.
Thread the meat onto skewers alongside peppers and tomatoes.
Grill over open coals, turning until charred and juicy.
Serve with lavash bread and grilled vegetables.

items.heading: Armenian Dolma
details: Key ingredients: grape leaves, ground lamb, rice, herbs
Mix ground lamb with rice, onion and fresh herbs.
Wrap small portions of filling tightly in grape leaves.
Layer the rolls snugly in a pot and cover with water.
Simmer gently until the rice is cooked and the leaves are tender.
